title: Mod Manager Bridge
author: ModManager
tag_line: Localhost HTTP bridge connecting Desktop Mod Manager with BeamNG.drive's authenticated repository API.
message:
[B]Mod Manager Bridge v2.3.3[/B]
Loopback HTTP bridge bound strictly to [B]127.0.0.1[/B] with per-install token verification ([B]X-Bridge-Token[/B]) and Host header validation.

[H3]Endpoints[/H3]
[LIST][*][B]GET /v1/health[/B] — Bridge status, online session, and authentication state[*][B]GET /v1/state[/B] — Update enabled flag or listener port[*][B]GET /v1/reload[/B] — Safely hot-reload the Bridge Lua extension[*][B]GET /v1/mods[/B] — Query official repository catalog via s1/v4/getMods[*][B]GET /v1/subscribed[/B] — List subscribed mods (own=1)[*][B]GET /v1/mod?id=...[/B] — Fetch full mod metadata via s1/v4/getMod[*][B]GET /v1/subscribe?id=...[/B] / [B]GET /v1/unsubscribe?id=...[/B] — Manage subscriptions[/LIST]

[H3]Zero-Impact Polling & Auto-Wakeup[/H3]
Uses a non-blocking TCP socket at 150ms idle intervals during gameplay, and checks [B]modmanager_bridge.json[/B] every 1s while paused for automatic remote resume wakeup.
